1.Title: New Mechanics
1.Description: Added a Guild Enrollment mode that allows you to be placed into the same League with other players from your Guild.

2.Description: Added a new Oath Pact system. Spend diamonds to sign an Oath Pact and get more diamonds if you meet certain requirements.

3.Description: Added a League Contribution system. Play the game mode to earn contribution and rewards.

4.Description: Added a Caravan system. Caravans appear in cities, and you can buy or exchange for Caravan Bundles.

5.Description: Improved League management. League Leaders can manage permissions, and players with permissions can issue battle commands.
